correctness.rationale: Explicit monomiality lemma from independent basis squares, necessary and sufficient diagonal/swapped equations, complete support stratification, exact determinant and cube-map counts, and full simple-subpopulation count establish the theorem for every prime power q. value.rationale: A natural quantitative rigidity invariant for uniformly sampled perfect evolution algebras is fully determined by exact group-type multiplicities, including field-characteristic and cubic-arithmetic phases, and a simple-algebra conditioning. Prior orbit counts and group-type classifications are substantively coarser. The result is motivated by recent automorphism-group and finite-field questions, not a parameter-renaming exercise.
